title: Pesto Pesto Tofu
description: A quick and easy vegetarian dish featuring silken tofu smothered in a rich pesto sauce.
instructions: 2. Cut the tofu into 1-inch cubes and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
3. Drizzle the jerkied zesty sauce over the tofu cubes and toss to coat.
4. Bake the tofu in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, flipping halfway through.
5. While the tofu is baking, mix the pesto sauce with a squeeze of lemon juice and a sprinkle of salt and pepper.
6. Once the tofu is done baking, remove it from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
7. Serve the tofu with the pesto sauce spooned over the top.
8. Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
